name: 또가스
motifs: Rounded purple shell shapes become curved shoulder plates, a sculpted breastplate and hip panels; short geyser-shaped protrusions become small blunt vent ridges on plate edges. Its cream skull-and-crossbones marking is a decorative painted motif across the breastplate, not lettering. No creature head or carried sphere.
light: In an empty atmospheric industrial courtyard at violet dusk, the adult woman stands in a balanced front three-quarter guard, open empty hands well apart. Glossy violet curved slim armor with cream decorative markings and subtle small vent ridges. Full body and footwear with margins.
casual: In an empty neon cabaret rehearsal room, marking a lively dance step beside a velvet curtain, both hands open at different heights clear of her body. Late-night magenta and cyan stage light.

Original stage-assistant event fashion: securely lined purple satin corset-style bodice, short cream asymmetrical skirt over fitted opaque shorts, sheer black tights and ankle boots. Bare shoulders arms and upper chest, tiny skull earring.

At a screen-printing workshop on a cloudy afternoon, leaning slightly toward an ink tray while lifting a blank print frame with two hands at widely separated corners. Side torso, face turned to viewer, hands fully readable; lavender ink, concrete and diffuse windows.
Opaque charcoal sleeveless zip-front fitted top, low-slung lavender utility trousers and cream waist apron. Bare arms shoulders and a narrow midriff, small round pin.

On an empty urban rooftop at sunrise after a workout, stretching the arms outward at chest height with open relaxed hands, feet planted, face toward camera. Skyline under amber dawn. Whole body and ample rooftop context.
Opaque lavender racerback sports bra with secure cream band, high-waisted charcoal cycling shorts, white sneakers. Bare midriff arms and lower legs; small violet wristband.

comparison.scope: Bellossom plan read; six Exeggcute and Cubone casual images visually compared. Earlier plans in this batch also compared.
